barbecue-planner.title: BBQ planner
barbecue-planner.description: Pick dishes and seasonings for 1–20 people: it works out purchase weights and skewer counts, seasoning and consumable quantities, marinade ratios, a grill timeline with real clock times, grate size, charcoal and safe core temperatures — with a checkable, strikable, printable list.

dish.noSearchResult: Nothing matches — try another word, or clear the box to browse the groups.

qty.hint: Auto: the engine splits each dish across what you picked, based on headcount. Manual: type a quantity on every picked card.

sauce.basicHint: Bottled and bagged seasonings you use straight away — only the checked ones reach the shopping list.
sauce.hint: {{picked}} of {{total}} selected. Mix rubs, bastes and dips to taste; marinades are not chosen here — they come with the meat you ordered.
sauce.noFit: Nothing on this table fits it

toolbar.needDishes: Nothing ordered yet — pick a few dishes and the totals and grate advice appear here.

recipe.refHint: Every mix we sourced is listed as-is. This is a reference, not your shopping sheet: it neither follows the dishes you picked nor scales to the head count. Choose what to buy under rubs & dips in the menu.

timeline.startHint: Clock times run back from {{time}}; a lead longer than midnight shows the previous day.

equipment.batchNote: Only the 150 cm tier has a sourced batch count; the rest are scaled by grate length.
equipment.heatNote: Aim above 200 ℃; two seconds over the grate is high heat, four is medium.
equipment.yakitoriTitle: Yakitori coal beds and indoor replicas
equipment.yieldBody: American quantities are already inflated by cooking yield (brisket 43 %, pork butt 50 %, loin 65 %, whole chicken 34 %). The rule of thumb is one finished pound per 2.6 people.

shop.qtyHint: Edit any quantity with − / + or by typing. Zero means "not this time" — the row stays on screen so you can undo it, but it leaves the copy text and the exported image. Quantities only change their own row: charcoal, skewer totals and marinade ratios keep running off the researched baseline.
shop.textHint: When the browser blocks clipboard access (non-HTTPS page, or the window lost focus), select and copy here. Rows set to zero never appear in this text.

barbecue-planner.emptyResult: Nothing is grillable with this combination — change the device or relax the diet switches.
barbecue-planner.conflictTitle: The sources disagree on these points; the tool takes no side — you choose the reading.
barbecue-planner.disclaimer: Compiled from published recipes, regulator guidance and industry standards — reference, not specification. Adjust to your own grill and ingredients.

chinese-kinship-calculator.title: Chinese Kinship Calculator
chinese-kinship-calculator.description: Pick or type a relation chain to get the exact Chinese kinship term, with reverse lookup from a term and a generation tree view.
chinese-kinship-calculator.chainEmpty: Tap the terms below, or type a chain like 爸爸的哥哥
chinese-kinship-calculator.resultEmpty: Tap a term to see how to address them
chinese-kinship-calculator.resultInvalid: Cannot resolve this chain — undo and try again
chinese-kinship-calculator.treeEmpty: Build a chain to see how the term is derived

fortune-draw.title: Daily Fortune Draw
fortune-draw.description: Shake the tube and draw your daily fortune — boosted luck on holidays, same name same result per day, all computed locally
fortune-draw.fixedHint: "Draw Today's Lot" stays fixed for the same name on the same day; "Random Draw" redraws every time, no limits
fortune-draw.emptyHint: Enter a name and draw your fortune for today
fortune-draw.disclaimer: For fun only | Trust science | No superstition

unit-converter.title: Unit Converter
unit-converter.description: Convert length, weight, data size, speed and area units with the factor shown, so you can check the math instead of guessing it.
